digest.component_or_area: LLM capability routing and model profile interpretation
propositions: Two capability decisions currently use fragile provider-name string matching (startswith checks), causing silent feature loss for Bedrock-hosted Claude whose model string says 'bedrock' not 'anthropic'

pydantic-ai exposes per-vendor capability records via ModelProfile that should replace string routing, but lazy model strings created by S1 lack a .profile attribute and require profile resolution from vendor-specific paths

Bedrock Claude profile is a BedrockModelProfile sibling rather than AnthropicModelProfile subclass, requiring both isinstance and field-presence checks to identify correctly without importing boto3 in CI
The rebar override table must force Claude (both direct and Bedrock-hosted) to PromptedOutput despite upstream's supports_json_schema_output=True, preserving the existing tolerant-parse contract

Capability routing logic must move to a new leaf module capabilities.py to respect S1's attested 300-LOC criterion on providers.py, with cache_settings_for() as the single seam replacing scattered startswith branches
